meaning.en: Home Shopping Network, an American television channel.
meaning.vi: Home Shopping Network, một kênh truyền hình của Mỹ.

sentences.en: You can even watch HSN live on your computer and chat with other customers about the products.
sentences.vi: Bạn thậm chí có thể xem HSN trực tiếp trên máy tính của mình và trò chuyện với những khách hàng khác về sản phẩm.

sentences.en: Some items can only be found online, so using the website exclusively or in connecting with watching HSN is a great way to discover new products and save some money.
sentences.vi: Một số mặt hàng chỉ có thể được tìm thấy trực tuyến, vì vậy sử dụng trang web độc quyền hoặc kết nối với xem HSN là một cách tuyệt vời để khám phá các sản phẩm mới và tiết kiệm một số tiền.

sentences.en: The Home Shopping Network offers an option known as HSN Flex Pay.

sentences.en: If you are, then shopping channels like QVC and the Home Shopping Network (HSN) occasionally offer Dell laptops for sale on TV.

sentences.en: His DVD guitar lessons and instruments have become well recognized from his TV infomercials and appearances on HSN and QVC.

sentences.en: She first showcased her former collection on QVC in 2006 and now has introduced her latest collection on the Home Shopping Network / HSN.

sentences.en: Forever Your Girl is available on HSN is very popular due to its affordability - most sells for under $100 - and for its stylish appeal.

sentences.en: Be sure to watch HSN to catch Paula Abdul selling her jewelry and showcasing her latest designs.

sentences.en: Tori created the Tori Spelling Collection in 2007 as an exclusive Home Shopping Network jewelry (HSN) venture in order to create quality trendy fashion jewelry at an affordable price.
